examples.sentence: 我每天学习一两个小时汉语。
examples.romanization: wǒ měitiān xuéxí yī liǎng gè xiǎoshí Hànyǔ。
examples.translation: I study Chinese for one or two hours a day.

title: 把 + Ｏ + Ｖ + 了 (V’ed the O)
longExplanation: V’ed the O. Pinyin: bǎ + Ｏ + Ｖ + le

pattern: 不要/别/没把 + Ｏ + Ｖ + 了
title: 不要/别/没把 + Ｏ + Ｖ + 了 (don’t/don’t/haven’t V’ed the O)
longExplanation: don’t/don’t/haven’t V’ed the O. Pinyin: bùyào/ bié/ méi bǎ + Ｏ + Ｖ + le
formation: bùyào/ bié/ méi bǎ + Ｏ + Ｖ + le

examples.sentence: 周末我一般十点左右起床。
examples.romanization: zhōumò wǒ yībān shí diǎn zuǒyòu qǐchuáng。
examples.translation: I usually get up at around 10 o'clock on weekends.

title: 就 V/A (just (better than expected))
longExplanation: just (better than expected). Pinyin: jiù V/A

examples.sentence: 坐飞机一个小时就到了。
examples.romanization: zuòfēijī yī gè xiǎoshí jiù dàoliǎo。
examples.translation: It takes only an hour to get there by plane.

title: 才 V/A (just (worse than expected))
longExplanation: just (worse than expected). Pinyin: cái V/A

examples.translation: How come you only came just now? (Why are you so late?)

pattern: 把 + O + V + 在/到 +  PLACE
title: 把 + O + V + 在/到 +  PLACE (V’d the O to PLACE)
longExplanation: V’d the O to PLACE. Pinyin: bǎ + O + V + zài/ dào + PLACE
formation: bǎ + O + V + zài/ dào + PLACE

examples.sentence: 我把照片放在你包里了。
examples.romanization: wǒ bǎ zhàopiàn fàng zài nǐ bāo lǐ le。
examples.translation: I put the photo in your bag.

title: V + motion V + 来/去 ((compound complements of direction))
longExplanation: (compound complements of direction). Pinyin: V + motion V + lái/ qù

examples.sentence: 明天我们一起把礼物送过去。
examples.romanization: míngtiān wǒmen yīqǐ bǎ lǐwù sòng guòqu。
examples.translation: Let's send the gift over together tomorrow.

pattern: 一边 + V1 + 一边 + V2
title: 一边 + V1 + 一边 + V2 (V1 while V2)
longExplanation: V1 while V2. Pinyin: yībiān + V1 + yībiān + V2

title: 把 + O + V + result (V the O until RESULT)
longExplanation: V the O until RESULT. Pinyin: bǎ + O + V + result

examples.romanization: wǒ bǎ yīfu xǐ gānjìng le。

title: 把 + O + V + direction (V the O to DIRECTION)
longExplanation: V the O to DIRECTION. Pinyin: bǎ + O + V + direction

examples.romanization: tā bǎ shuǐguǒ ná guòlái le。

title: 先……再/又……然后…… (First, then, then, …)
longExplanation: First, then, then, …. Pinyin: xiān…… zài/ yòu…… ránhòu……

examples.sentence: 我先坐了公共汽车，又坐了地铁，然后才到小刚家。
examples.romanization: wǒ xiān zuò le gōnggòngqìchē， yòu zuò le dìtiě， ránhòu cái dào xiǎo gāng jiā。
examples.translation: I first took the bus, then took the subway, and then went to Xiaogang's house.

title: 除了 N 以外 (except N)
longExplanation: except N. Pinyin: chúle N yǐwài

examples.sentence: 除了这个汉字以外，别的我都认识。
examples.romanization: chúle zhège hànzì yǐwài， biéde wǒ dōu rènshi。
examples.translation: Except for this Chinese character, I know everything else.

title: 除了……(以外)，还…… (not only…, but also…)
longExplanation: not only…, but also…. Pinyin: chúle……( yǐwài)， hái……

examples.sentence: 上网除了看新闻(以外)，还可以听音乐。
examples.romanization: shàngwǎng chúle kàn xīnwén( yǐwài)， hái kěyǐ tīng yīnyuè。
examples.translation: In addition to watching the news, you can listen to music too.

examples.romanization: zhōumò nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuàn ma?
examples.translation: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
